svg.text: HBM (large, slow: every read/write is the cost)
standard: S and P are written to HBM, then read back

g.text: one tile of Q (rows) × one tile of K, V (columns)
keep only: running max m, running sum ℓ, partial O
backward: recompute S, P from Q, K, V and the saved m, ℓ

svg.text: FLOPs are unchanged (recomputation adds some); what shrinks is HBM traffic. Exact in arithmetic; bitwise, summation order differs.
